blocked_reason: The rule is a system-wide scope boundary but does not define a finite acceptance oracle for absence of every out-of-scope function. No unlisted feature or endpoint may be invented for a negative test.
objective: Determine whether MMS remains within every function and integration in its stated scope without asserting unlisted behavior.
Verify role assignment can use an available institutional employee identity without changing that identity data.
Verify a role assignment is not recorded when the required employee identity is unavailable.

blocked_reason: The specifications state MMS does not own employee master data but do not define a specific employee-management operation or rejection response to exercise. No API/action is inferred.
objective: Verify the complete employee master-data ownership boundary.

Verify an unregistered Student cannot submit a meaningful deregistration request.
Verify an approved deregistration becomes effective on the next calendar day after Caretaker approval.

Verify a missing reason, an unsupported reason, or Other without an explanation is not accepted.

blocked_reason: The specifications condition date changes on external mess policy but do not define permitted ranges, limits, or acceptance outcomes. No modified date range or expected result can be asserted.
objective: Determine acceptance limits and billing effects when Caretaker modifies rebate dates before approval.
Verify vacation survey notifications/availability are limited to currently registered Students.
Verify a registered Student who does not respond before the deadline receives a default No response.
Verify an explicit response submitted before the deadline is not replaced by default No.

blocked_reason: The specifications say 'before the deadline' and default at the deadline but do not state whether a response at the exact deadline instant is timely. No boundary convention is assumed.
objective: Determine the outcome for a response submitted exactly at the response-deadline instant.
Verify a special-food request submitted at least one calendar day before its requested date is allowed by the lead-time rule.
Verify a special-food request submitted less than one calendar day before its requested date is not allowed.

blocked_reason: The exact decision period is institution-defined and is not specified. The intended 12-hour reference is explicitly not a frozen policy value; no numeric threshold or exact-boundary result may be asserted.
objective: Verify the institution-defined timeout threshold and default-rejection boundary.
Verify charges for approved special-food requests are added to the Student monthly bill.

objective: Determine whether a charge is reversed or suppressed after an approved special-food request is later Cancelled.
Verify Request and decision states are tracked as Requested followed by Approved or Rejected.

objective: Verify the full boundary between MMS behavior and institutional policy definition.

objective: Determine whether Mess Admin can view the weekly menu.
